long_description:
Some songs make you sing along. Some make you smile. And some instantly take you back to a time, a place, a memory. Chandrabindoo has been doing all three for generations of Bengalis.

This Bijoya, Prabashi Association of Portland brings one of Bengal’s most loved and iconic bands to Portland for an evening filled with the unmistakable wit, nostalgia, melodies, and energy of Chandrabindoo — LIVE!

From songs we grew up listening to, to the quirky lyrics and effortless humor that became their signature, Chandrabindoo has created a musical language entirely their own. Come sing along to the favorites, rediscover old memories, and experience that familiar Chandrabindoo magic with friends and family.

And what better time than Bijoya — when Pujo may be over, but the adda, celebration, and togetherness certainly aren’t.

📅 Saturday, October 24, 2026

📍 Portland, Oregon

Prabashi Bijoya Sammilani 2026

Chandrabindoo. Live. One unforgettable Bengali evening in Portland.
